Note by me: In the book the attached note refers to both *3.27 and *3.26 as being
called the principle of simplification much like *2.02. Also, I normally leave out the
QEDs as they don't really do much ohter than restate the proof and theroem to be
proved in shorthand but, here, it's worth pointing out that they directly and
explicitly cite *3.01 as part of the QED. Other instances of *3.01 being inferred,
explicitly or otherwise, will be omitted from the graph/proof for reasons of
concision and clarity, as will be references to *1.01, if they are not part of the main
body of a proof/demonstration. Cf the text of *2.33 for more on that reasoning.
